title: Compose: static web tier
brief: Author a production Docker Compose file for a static web tier. Required services: web. Expose 8080:80. The stack must include: healthcheck, read_only. Do not use the latest tag, do not bake plaintext secrets into the file, and do not run as root.

evidence.E2: Host port mapping: 8080:80.
evidence.E3: Required controls: healthcheck, read_only.
evidence.E4: Base image family: nginx:1.27-alpine.
evidence.E5: Never use the latest tag or plaintext credentials in the compose file.

reference.compose_yaml:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "true"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 3
    read_only: true
    ports: ["8080:80"]
